purpose: Teach: 後世/頭部/低音/女子大/無能/野望/処女/侮辱

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、後世に残す史料の保存研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on archival preservation and historical records for future generations, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, attentive. Genuine curiosity without condescension. Slight pause after the name — giving him space to settle. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、頭部外傷のスポーツ医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about sports medicine and head injuries.
lines.style: Quiet, slightly uncertain. Pause before answering, as if checking himself. Careful articulation. The tone of someone not quite sure his work measures up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、低音域の音楽療法を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on music therapy in the lower frequencies, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gently reflective. A slight tilt of the head. Not testing him — genuinely wanting to hear what he'll say. Warm baseline.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、女子大の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually I focused on the history of women's universities.
lines.style: Soft correction underneath. Not defensive, but clarifying what he actually did. Small breath before the answer. Slight fade at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織における無能扱いの心理学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper explored the psychology of incompetence in organizational settings, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Leaning in slightly with real interest. Clear diction. The rhythm of someone genuinely curious about what he'll confirm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、独裁者の野望を心理分析する研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched the psychology of authoritarian ambition and power dynamics.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Not proud, but standing by the work. Slight firmness on the key terms. A pause that gives weight to what he's saying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、処女作の出版条件研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you researched publishing conditions for debut works, didn't you?
lines.style: Warmly reflective. Inviting, not interrogating. Soft opening. A sense of genuine interest in what answer will come.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治的侮辱罪の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied the history of political insult laws.
lines.style: Quieter, with finality. A small breath closing off the exchange. Serious tone. The sense of him stepping back slightly, the conversation settling.
